name: Snail Garden
source: maplestory.io /api/GMS/8/map/1000004 (local copy docs/research/raw/gms_v8/1000004.json); geometry identical in gms_v22
conventions: MapleStory px, y grows DOWNWARD. Tier ids T0.. sorted top-to-bottom (T0 = highest). Ladder from_tier = tier at the BOTTOM end, to_tier = tier at the TOP end (null = no foothold there). kind: ground = attached to map bottom; ledge = raised block standing on ground or an object top; floating = free platform; slope = sloped ground piece.

layering.ground: T21 y335 -> T22 y395 -> T23 y455 -> T25 basin y515 -> T24 y455 (stepped bowl, deepest at x1569-2391)
layering.low_row: stepping stones y155-275 over the basin (T12,T14-T20) + door-block top T13 y185

tiers.note: vegetable-garden island: fruit bushes + carrot patch

raised earth block (layer 0) standing on T21: walls x=816 and x=1164 run from y185 down to y330, so it is 150 px tall. The exit door object is at x979 on its front face. Its top carries 2 strawberry bushes.
west ground shelf; 6 spawn points (sp x827-1276) drop onto it; exit out00 at x980

riser 60px DOWN east to T25 at x=1569

terrain_style: Tile set tS=grassySoil (raw WZ <layer>/info/tS). Grass-topped earth: thick bright-green grass fringe over olive-brown mossy cobbled dirt with embedded grey boulders; floating platforms have ragged dirt undersides; ground blocks are solid dirt down to the map bottom (v8 render). Background set bS=grassySoil: tiled blue sky (no.0), drifting white cumulus clouds (no.1, type 4 = horizontal scroll), a distant domed grassy hill (no.2), a single big leafy tree (no.3), and a horizontally tiled meadow strip with golden grass (no.4) with the strongest parallax (raw WZ back/<n>; sprites viewed at Data/Map/Back/grassySoil.img/back/<no>).
